stories.title: Lock Recovery and Orphan Detection Logic
stories.description: Implement recovery logic to detect expired/orphaned locks and allow safe re-acquisition. Include validation to prevent takeover of active locks, and fallback handling when TTL index cleanup is delayed. Log recovery events for audit.

stories.title: Lock Mechanism Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests covering lock acquisition, renewal, expiration, concurrent contention, and recovery scenarios. Validate TTL behavior, ownership enforcement, and Brain runner integration under failure conditions.
